newsitem.title: USA: PIE Mutual to switch to for-profit status.
newsitem.headline: PIE Mutual to switch to for-profit status.

text.p: PIE Mutual Insurance Co said Monday its board has approved its conversion to a for-profit stock corporation.

The company said it has submitted its conversion plan to the Ohio Department of Insurance. The plan calls for policyholders to exchange current equity in the mutual company for common shares in PIE Insurance Co.
PIE insures more than 9,000 policyholders in nine states. It has assets of $281.5 million and a surplus of $65.6 million.
